title: The equatorward California Current
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature, salinity, velocity, sea surface height and mixed-layer thickness for 2011-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), characterize the equatorward California Current: its position, strength and vertical structure through the seasonal cycle, how it changed from year to year, including during 2014-2016, and what controls those changes.
